Description: "Update the search suggestions overlay top offset to account for SafeArea's top padding, preventing it from obscuring the search bar on devices with notches or status bars."
Instruction: "Change the top positioning of the search suggestions overlay from absolute 65 to MediaQuery.of(context).padding.top + 65."
ReplacementContent:
"    return Positioned(
      top: MediaQuery.of(context).padding.top + 65, // Positioned right below the AppBar (accounting for safe area top padding)
      left: 16,
      right: 16,
      bottom: MediaQuery.of(context).viewInsets.bottom + 80 > MediaQuery.of(context).size.height - 200
          ? 10
          : null,"
TargetContent:
"    return Positioned(
      top: 65, // Positioned right below the AppBar
      left: 16,
      right: 16,
      bottom: MediaQuery.of(context).viewInsets.bottom + 80 > MediaQuery.of(context).size.height - 200
          ? 10
          : null,"
